Reference GL

Glossary

Short definitions for the words this course uses.

Open the first entry

  1. 01TokenA chunk of text the model reads or writes. Not always a whole word.4 min
  2. 02Context windowThe token budget for one request, shared by instructions, sources, conversation, and the answer.4 min
  3. 03TemperatureA sampling control. Lower sticks to likely tokens. Higher lets less likely tokens through.4 min
  4. 04HallucinationFluent text that is not grounded in a source, a tool result, or a test you can check.4 min
  5. 05Structured outputA response constrained to a schema, then validated by your code.4 min
  6. 06EmbeddingA vector for a piece of text, used for similarity search. Produced by an embedding model, not by the chat model.4 min
  7. 07ChunkThe piece of a document you index, retrieve, and cite.4 min
  8. 08Hybrid searchKeyword search and vector search together, merged into one candidate list.4 min
  9. 09RerankerA model or rule that reorders a short candidate list for one question.4 min
  10. 10CitationAn id and a span a person can open, attached to a claim.4 min
  11. 11Tool callA proposed function name and arguments. Your code validates them and runs the handler.4 min
  12. 12AgentA loop that lets a model call tools, read observations, and stop on a rule you set.4 min
  13. 13MCPModel Context Protocol. A standard way for a host's client to talk to a server that offers tools, resources, and prompts.4 min
  14. 14MCP host, client, and serverThe host is the app a person uses. The client speaks MCP. The server implements the capabilities.4 min
  15. 15EvalA versioned set of tasks, a scorer, and a record of the model, prompt, and index you ran.4 min
  16. 16Golden setThe small task set you trust enough to gate a change. This course starts at ten tasks you can explain.4 min
  17. 17Judge modelA model that applies a written rubric to an answer. It is a second system, with its own error rate.4 min
  18. 18LoRALow-Rank Adaptation. Trains small matrices while the base model stays frozen.4 min
  19. 19QuantizationStoring an existing model's weights in fewer bits so they fit and load faster.4 min
  20. 20Prompt injectionUntrusted text — a page, a ticket, a tool description — that tries to instruct the model.4 min
  21. 21TraceThe ordered record of tool calls, arguments, results, approvals, and stops.4 min
  22. 22Human approvalA person confirms the exact arguments of a side effect before the handler runs.4 min
  23. 23Coding agentAn agent whose tools read and edit a repository and may run commands you allowed.4 min
  24. 24AllowlistThe tools or commands that may run. Everything else is denied.4 min
